These three unmodified `ComponentBody` records are serialized from TI's
TMDS62LEVM Rev. B `PROC181E1-1_BRD_11_3.pcbdoc`, available in
https://www.ti.com/lit/zip/sprcal9. The existing reference manifest pins that
PcbDoc to SHA-256
`8444ad8456ff028b7aa11389362ba2fbc01291e87ff46e394576cb044c3612fc`.

The component indexes are 1453 (C147), 1454 (C146), and 1514 (bottom-side U95).
Their clockwise contours reproduce inward-facing extrusions and a visible cap
coplanar with the PCB surface. The test uses the original component positions
and a rectangular PCB crop for the close-up snapshots. It does not change the
body contours, heights, colors, or layer direction.
